title: Schatten-q Crouzeix Constants and the Hilbert-Schmidt Phase Transition: Universal Conformal Majorization on M_2(C), Odd-Even Clifford Parity Staircases, and Double-Layer Trace Bounds
abstract: We introduce and analyze the normalized Schatten-q Crouzeix constant Psi_q(A) = sup_{||f||_{W(A)} <= 1} ||f(A)||_{q,norm} for n x n complex matrices A and q in [1, infinity], where ||X||_{q,norm} = (n^{-1} tr(|X|^q))^{1/q} is normalized so that Psi_q(A) = 1 for every normal matrix. Four main results govern this functional calculus across dimensions and exponents: (1) Universal Linear/Disk Majorization and Clifford Parity Staircase: for every n >= 1 and A in M_n(C), the singular values of A are weakly majorized by s^(n) w(A), where s^(n) = (2,...,2,[1],0,...,0), yielding the sharp odd-even parity staircase sup ||A||_{q,norm}/w(A) = ((floor(n/2)*2^q + (n mod 2))/n)^{1/q}, Clifford Cl_2 algebraic rigidity of equality for even n, and extension to all centered disk functions (f(0)=0, w(A)<=1) via Berger's unitary 2-dilation; (2) Universal Ky Fan Dominance on M_2(C): for every non-normal 2 x 2 matrix A_R with elliptical numerical range E_R (Joukowsky radius R > 1), the odd Riemann conformal map phi_R: E_R -> D simultaneously maximizes every unitarily invariant norm ||f(A_R)||_Phi over ||f||_{E_R} <= 1, yielding the exact Jacobi theta formula Psi_q(A_R) = (theta_2(R^{-4})/theta_3(R^{-4})) * ((R^q + R^{-q})/2)^{1/q}; (3) Exact Hilbert-Schmidt Critical Phase Transition at q_c = 2: for all q >= 2, the nilpotent disk J_2 is uniquely extremal (Psi_q(2) = 2^{1-1/q}, proved via an elementary Jacobi-product inequality for theta_2/theta_3), whereas for every 1 <= q < 2 the disk J_2 strictly fails to be extremal and an interior non-degenerate ellipse R*(q) strictly beats 2^{1-1/q}, with critical divergence R*(q) ~ 4^{1/(4-2q)} as q -> 2^- and exact trace-norm constant Psi_1(2) = 1.11557524... > 1 (at R* = 2.041101, c* = 1.551169) despite Psi_1(J_2) = 1; and (4) Universal n-Dimensional Double-Layer Trace Bound: a self-contained double-layer POVM identity proves ||f(A)||_{2,norm}^2 <= 4||f||_{W(A)}^2 + n^{-1} sum |f(lambda_j)|^2 <= 5||f||_{W(A)}^2 for all n >= 1, strictly improving Crouzeix-Palencia's 1 + sqrt(2) to sqrt(5) for all 1 <= q <= 2 (and 2 when f vanishes on sigma(A)), and to 5^{1/q}(1+sqrt(2))^{1-2/q} for q in [2, infinity). The exact denominator-cleared algebraic core (13 public theorems, 1 public definition, 2 private helpers) is formally verified in Lean 4.36.0 (zero sorry, zero grind, zero custom axioms).
